
=== A4a. Give TestNet's DAO wallet MainNet's escrows and grants (TestNet only, before B1)
  A4a#1  npm run rollout:testnet-parity -- -n testnet --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  A4a#2  npm run rollout:testnet-parity -- -n testnet --confirm
  A4a#3  npm run rollout:testnet-parity -- -n testnet --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"

=== B1. Phase 2a: install the new UpdateAkitaDAOPlugin
  B1#1  npx ts-node --transpile-only scripts/principal-phase2a-update-plugin.ts -n testnet -v "$V" --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  B1#2  npx ts-node --transpile-only scripts/principal-phase2a-update-plugin.ts -n testnet -v "$V" --manifest receipts/phase2a.json --fund-sponsor --register --confirm
  B1#3  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)

=== B2. Deploy the validator and upgrade the DAO
  B2#1  npm run update:dao -- -n testnet -v "$V" --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  B2#2  npm run update:dao -- -n testnet -v "$V"
  B2#3  npm run deploy:dao-plugin -- -n testnet -v "$V" --manifest receipts/dao-plugin.json --register
  B2#4  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)

=== B3. Set guild_fees
  B3#1  npm run update:guild-creation-cost -- -n testnet --cost 200000000 --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  B3#2  npm run update:guild-creation-cost -- -n testnet --cost 200000000

  B3a#2  npm run update:creation-fees -- -n testnet --staking-pool 100000000 --auction 50000000 --raffle 50000000 --confirm

=== B3b. Set the revenue split to 80/5/15

  B3b#2  npm run update:revenue-splits -- -n testnet --split rec_krby=80,rec_mod=5,rec_gov=15 --confirm

=== H1. Meta, MetaPlugin, PayPlugin and the rev_meta escrow
  H1#1  npm run deploy:meta -- -n testnet -v "$V" --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  H1#2  npm run deploy:meta -- -n testnet -v "$V" --manifest receipts/meta.json --register
  H1#3  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)
  [read] export META=$(npm run -s rollout:id -- -n testnet --app meta)
  [read] export META_ADDRESS=$(npm run -s rollout:id -- -n testnet --app meta --address)
  H1#6  npm run deploy:meta-plugin -- -n testnet -v "$V" --config "{\"registry\":\"$META\"}" --manifest receipts/meta-plugin.json --register
  H1#7  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)
  H1#8  npm run set:policy-writer -- -n testnet --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  H1#9  npm run set:policy-writer -- -n testnet --confirm
  H1#10  npm run install:policy-writer-grant -- -n testnet --dry-run
  H1#11  npm run install:policy-writer-grant -- -n testnet --confirm
  H1#12  npm run deploy:pay-plugin -- -n testnet -v "$V" --config "{\"registry\":\"$META\"}" --manifest receipts/pay-plugin.json --register
  H1#13  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)
  H1#14  npm run update:dao-wallet-plugins -- -n testnet --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  H1#15  npm run update:dao-wallet-plugins -- -n testnet --confirm-update
  H1#16  npm run create:dao-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_meta --execute
  H1#17  npm run update:app-dao-escrow -- -n testnet --app meta --escrow rev_meta --dry-run
  H1#18  npm run update:app-dao-escrow -- -n testnet --app meta --escrow rev_meta --confirm
  H1#19  npm run register:revenue-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_meta --source "$META_ADDRESS" --dry-run
  H1#20  npm run register:revenue-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_meta --source "$META_ADDRESS" --confirm
  H1#21  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)

=== H2. Guilds
  H2#1  npm run create:dao-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_guilds --execute
  [read] export REV_GUILDS_APP=$(npm run -s rollout:id -- -n testnet --escrow rev_guilds)
  H2#3  npm run deploy:guild-factory -- -n testnet -v "$V" --revenue-escrow-app "$REV_GUILDS_APP" --revenue-escrow-name rev_guilds --dry-run --sender "$CREATOR"
  H2#4  npm run deploy:guild-factory -- -n testnet -v "$V" --revenue-escrow-app "$REV_GUILDS_APP" --revenue-escrow-name rev_guilds --manifest receipts/guild-factory.json --register --confirm-mainnet
  H2#5  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)
  [read] export GUILD_FACTORY=$(npm run -s rollout:id -- -n testnet --app guildFactory)
  [read] export GUILD_FACTORY_ADDRESS=$(npm run -s rollout:id -- -n testnet --app guildFactory --address)
  H2#8  npm run deploy:guild-plugin -- -n testnet -v "$V" --config "{\"factory\":\"$GUILD_FACTORY\",\"guild\":\"0\"}" --manifest receipts/guild-plugin.json --register
  H2#9  npm run register:revenue-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_guilds --source "$GUILD_FACTORY_ADDRESS" --dry-run
  H2#10  npm run register:revenue-escrow -- -n testnet --escrow rev_guilds --source "$GUILD_FACTORY_ADDRESS" --confirm
  H2#11  (cd ../akita-sdk && npm run build)
